source_verification_receipts.version: BMC Medical Research Methodology 20:165, 2020, open-access version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper compares all-control and concurrent-only two-stage analyses under linear and step trends, finding stage adjustment equivalent to concurrent-only analysis and possible failure of linear adjustment under nonlinear trends.

The paper derives optimal honest confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for linear functionals over convex regression classes under Gaussian errors, furnishing a methodological but non-subsuming comparator.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Turn the fuzzy-prior handle into a finite, nondegenerate schedule family with an explicit sequential likelihood-ratio bound; state how its constants depend on the design primitives before attempting the universal comparison.

Solve at least one positive-drift three-block primal–dual LP and compare its exact value with the proposed radius, making the small-instance check a quantitative calibration rather than only a zero-drift regression test.
Add the unknown-drift adaptation question as a separately scoped follow-on theorem or impossibility result, using the nested TV balls and the same observed-law modulus.
